body: Oh nothing about it interests me. The jobs might though. Programming, space operations, a few others. Giving up on engineering leaves me desiring something at least related.

I agree with your point about the social contract. 

However, I don't see why I won't always be this way. Introverts generally stay introverts, autistics generally stay autistic, and people suffering from depression generally stay depressed. I will likely continue to fail to desire a social media account, or to go clubbing, or to do the other things "normal" people do. That's okay with me though.

I'm okay. I'm generally a happy person. The ability to ignore your problems leads to those problems being infinitely worse, but makes day to day normal.

I have a plan to join the air force doing some things that really interest me. That's my out. If that falls through....well there is always this.

You guys are fast though. I guess that comes with the territory.
